xpath.script: // Get a reference to the "Add Row" button and the table's tbody const addRowButton = document.getElementById("addRowButton"); const tableBody = document.querySelector("table tbody"); // Counter to keep track of added rows let rowCount = 1; // Function to add a new row to the table function addRow() { const newRow = document.createElement("tr"); newRow.innerHTML = ` `; tableBody.appendChild(newRow); rowCount++; } // Attach the addRow function to the button's click event addRowButton.addEventListener("click", addRow);
